raw_description: We are a small non-profit in Nagpur. We have a mountain of paper records for the students we tutor. We want to digitize this and perhaps use some basic AI to predict which students might need extra help before their exams based on their attendance and quiz scores.
structured_problem: Digitize paper student records, use machine learning to predict students in need of extra help based on attendance and quiz scores.

raw_description: We are a school in rural Maharashtra and we have all these paper records for attendance that keep getting lost or eaten by termites, we need some way to put them on the computer so we can track which kids are dropping out
We need a system to manage the people working for us pand provide them the reimbursements for the medicines they use to treat the animals
structured_problem: Implement a digital platform to manage employee data and facilitate reimbursement claims for animal treatment-related medicine purchases.
